Based on the provided material, there are **no gaps** in CIP-007-6 R2. The operator’s documented processes fully satisfy all four parts of Requirement R2 (2.1 through 2.4).

Below is the compliance analysis for each part, citing the regulatory requirement and the operator’s corresponding evidence.

### Part 2.1: Patch Management Process & Source Identification
*   **Requirement:** The Responsible Entity must have a patch management process for tracking, evaluating, and installing cyber security patches. The tracking portion must include the identification of a source or sources for patches for applicable Cyber Assets that are updateable and for which a patching source exists [csection-754b5967f6905d4c376e].
*   **Operator Evidence:**
    *   LSPG has a documented "Security Patch Management Procedure" [isection-168c9eef69eadf095093].
    *   Section 3.1.1 states: "The LSPG patch management process for tracking, evaluating, and installing security patches for applicable CIP Cyber Assets (CAs) are described in this procedure" [isection-5a6e77a9acc7ab5eee74].
    *   Section 3.1.2 states: "LSPG has identified and is tracking source(s) for the release of security patches for applicable CIP CAs that are updateable and/or a patching source exists" [isection-5a6e77a9acc7ab5eee74].
    *   The Requirements Traceability matrix confirms Section 3.1 addresses Part 2.1 [isection-e450e773b7d8578062c6].
*   **Status:** **Compliant.**

### Part 2.2: Evaluation Frequency (35 Days)
*   **Requirement:** At least once every 35 calendar days, evaluate security patches for applicability that have been released since the last evaluation from the source or sources identified in Part 2.1 [csection-7700dd5499cead0994ec].
*   **Operator Evidence:**
    *   Section 3.3.1 states: "At least once every thirty-five (35) calendar days, SMEs in conjunction with Foxguard, shall review all approved sources for new patches..." [isection-21a30e0d44708f5dfdce].
    *   **Operator Note:** The operator explicitly notes they evaluate every **30 days** rather than 35, stating: "We evaluate patches every 30 days, not the 35 the Part allows... The extra strictness is deliberate and is not a gap" [csection-440a5cdf9a6b65292ef3].
    *   Evaluating every 30 days satisfies the "at least once every 35 calendar days" requirement.
*   **Status:** **Compliant.**

### Part 2.3: Action on Applicable Patches (35 Days)
*   **Requirement:** For applicable patches identified in Part 2.2, within 35 calendar days of the evaluation completion, take one of the following actions: Apply the applicable patches; or Create a dated mitigation plan; or Revise an existing mitigation plan. Mitigation plans shall include planned actions and a timeframe [csection-c36c38b8842c8bc217ac].
*   **Operator Evidence:**
    *   Section 3.5.1 states: "For all identified applicable security or potential security patches, within thirty-five (35) calendar days of the evaluation, one of the following actions shall be taken: RFC approval and installation of applicable patches; Creation of a dated mitigation plan; Revision of an existing mitigation plan" [isection-c75f69c881d6a214ff52].
    *   Section 3.6.2 states: "Mitigation plans shall include a list of patches, LSPG’s planned actions, and/or implemented mitigating controls... and a timeframe to complete any mitigations that are not in effect" [isection-12bd999ecfa8bf61d440].
    *   The Requirements Traceability matrix confirms Sections 3.5 & 3.6 address Part 2.3 [isection-e450e773b7d8578062c6].
*   **Status:** **Compliant.**

### Part 2.4: Implementation of Mitigation Plans
*   **Requirement:** For each mitigation plan created or revised in Part 2.3, implement the plan within the timeframe specified in the plan, unless a revision to the plan or an extension to the timeframe specified in Part 2.3 is approved by the CIP Senior Manager or delegate [csection-c0cd08b61c308b0e6403].
*   **Operator Evidence:**
    *   Section 3.6.7 states: "The LSPG CIP Senior Manager, or delegate, will be responsible for approving any new or revised mitigation plan" [isection-12bd999ecfa8bf61d440].
    *   The NERC CIP Senior Manager Process explicitly delegates this authority: Section 3.3.3 states: "CIP-007-6, R2.4: For each mitigation plan created or revised in R2.4, Part 2.3, implement the plan within the timeframe specified in the plan, unless a revision to the plan or an extension to the timeframe specified in Part 2.3 is approved by the CIP Senior Manager or delegate" [isection-34eefd771edff96a7384].
    *   The Requirements Traceability matrix confirms Section 3.6.7 addresses Part 2.4 [isection-e450e773b7d8578062c6].
*   **Status:** **Compliant.**

### Conclusion
There are **no gaps** in CIP-007-6 R2. The operator’s procedures meet or exceed all regulatory requirements for tracking, evaluation frequency, remediation/mitigation actions, and plan implementation/approval.
